## Supported regions

The service is available in the following regions:

_comment: Item 1 of 17. After excluding self, there are 16 siblings — exceeds preview cap of 15. sibling_ids MUST contain all 16 real IDs (full list). sibling_previews MUST contain exactly 16 entries: first 15 are real previews, the 16th is the overflow marker '... +1 more'.

Items 2..17 follow the same pattern. For each item, sibling_ids has 16 entries (all others, in order, excluding self), sibling_previews has 16 entries: first 15 real previews + overflow marker '... +1 more'. Assertion should verify: (a) sibling_ids length == total_siblings - 1 for every item, (b) sibling_previews length == min(total_siblings - 1, 15) + (1 if total_siblings - 1 > 15 else 0), (c) when overflow applies, the last preview entry starts with '... +' and ends with 'more'.
